name: rulereceipt
description: Check whether your agent followed your CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md rules. Installs a PreToolUse guard (refuses a command that breaks a file/branch rule, asks before an unapproved push/commit) and a Stop hook (won't let a session end on a broken rule or an unbacked 'done'), plus commands to check/audit/health/why. Runs the rulereceipt CLI locally.
